paragraphs: I'm applying for the Research Associate I role covering Energy. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Energy is the sector I've spent most of my MBA projects on, and equity research would let me go deep on it every day.

For a class project I built project- and portfolio-level models for a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, testing DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios, and compared senior debt, green loan and ABS structures. I also valued J.M. Smucker with comps and a DCF that I matched against a sell-side model, and analyzed financial statements for earnings quality across peers.
I'd bring careful models, fast reading of filings and clear write-ups to support the analyst's coverage. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
